cohort: Singleton births ≥36 weeks' gestation born between 2009 and 2016
finding: Several antenatal and intrapartum risk factors, including primigravida status, previous fetal death/stillbirth, maternal drug use, Rh sensitization, excessive gestational weight gain, placental abruption, ruptured uterus, meconium stained amniotic fluid, and cesarean delivery, were independently associated with HIE.
mod_finding: Delivery by cesarean-section was identified as an independent intrapartum risk factor for HIE.
